audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 5 and 6 read Skill while whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] each describe Sett winning ('your sustain out-grinds his passive shield', 'shred a low-damage Shen', 'you out-brawl him in every side-lane duel').
audit.why: The packet chart gives Sett all seven rows at a 53.83% win rate over 2783 games, and Shen's lane damage never catches up — his value is Stand United's map pressure.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 5, 6 -> Sett in both layers, ratings to 6/10.

audit.why: Four spikes, correctly placed. Shen's own spike is Stand United at 6 (200/180/160s) and it is a map spike, not a lane one — already framed that way.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text sharpened with the R-cancels-channel interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were absent: Spirit's Refuge blocks ATTACKS only, so Haymaker lands through it; The Show Stopper grounds Shadow Dash and Stand United; and Stand United is a channel that Facebreaker or The Show Stopper cancels outright.
audit.why: These are the only mechanics that decide the duel — the page instead repeated 'dodge the taunt' four times with no numbers.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, spikes[1].text and breakdown.cooldowns, with Shadow Dash at 18s/150 energy and Spirit's Refuge at 16s.
sources: champ-data/_kits/shen.json (W text, E cd 18/16/14/12/10 cost 150, R channel+dash flags)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed Shadow Dash twice and carried no numbers.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 and costs 150 energy — after he taunts he is empty, which is the punish window.
audit.corrected: Duplicate bullet replaced with Spirit's Refuge and its 16s cooldown.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash (Taunt): matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Shen Shadow Dash: Dashes in a line, taunting all enemies hit — his engage CC. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash: 18s at rank 1 and 150 energy — once he taunts he is empty. - Shen Spirit's Refuge: 16s at rank 1, and it blocks attacks only; your Haymaker lands straight through it.

edits.before: His engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only gap-closer, 18s at rank 1 — bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): His engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — E-stun + W him.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not spells — cash Haymaker inside it. Your R grounds Shadow Dash.

edits.before: The Show Stopper (R) plus grit shields beat Shen in a straight 1v1; even if he Stand United (R) to a teammate, the lane duel stays yours whenever his W is down.
edits.after: The Show Stopper grounds Shadow Dash and cancels Stand United outright — R him mid-channel and his team gets nothing, then finish the 1v1 while his W is down.
